Subject: Runtime Observability - expedited hire request (SLA commitment)

Hi Kimberly / Marissa —

Quick ask: EchoHealth (key pilot customer) has moved a subset of traffic to our dedicated inference cluster and contractually requested an operational SLA refinement for p99 latencies by end of Q4. We ran a short post-mortem and the primary gap is runtime observability and tail isolation: we need focused instrumentation, KV cache tracing, and a short-cycle remediation owner to drive lowering p99.

Requesting approval to open one Senior Runtime Observability Engineer (1.0 FTE) on the runtime/infra roster with an expedited timeline (target hire in ~3 weeks).

Why now:
- Contract requirement: EchoHealth PO 12489 includes a remedial SLA milestone tied to renewal.
- Impact: engineering estimate is ~25% reduction in p99 across dedicated workload if we staff this role and execute the recommended changes.
- Timeline: to meet the SLA milestone and preserve renewal we need the hire in October/early November.

Compensation ask:
- Role band: Senior (S4) is standard, but we've had candidate pushback on base comp in this market. I am requesting an in-flight exception to the comp band to allow up to S5 ceiling for this hire (or authorize a $20k signing bonus alternative). Attached: JD and comp band matrix.

Funding:
- Proposed split: 60% infra headcount, 40% SLA remediation / customer success reserve (will provide PO link).

Attachments: JD_Runtime_Observability.pdf, comp_band_matrix.xlsx

Next steps requested:
1) Approve opening the req and the comp-band exception (or signing bonus alternative).
2) If approved, authorize recruiting to run an expedited intake with Kate Liu (sourcer).
3) Ben — please confirm the funding split and any remaining approval steps on finance side.

Happy to jump on a 15 min sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Runtime Observability - expedited hire request (SLA commitment)

Thanks for the clear write-up, Logan. A few questions before I can sign off on a band exception: 

1) Can you quantify the cost delta if we permit S5 versus S4 (base + OTE + equity)? Please include 3-year TCO (salary + equity run-rate + hiring costs).
2) Who is the formal budget owner for the 40% SLA remediation fund? We need a PO / ledger code to allocate.
3) Stopping criteria: what metrics will the hire be accountable for (p99 target, regression thresholds, rollout cadence)?

If we can get those answers and Ben confirms funding availability, I can escalate to the comp committee for a one-off exception. As an alternative I would prefer authorizing an S4 with a structured signing bonus (one-time) and an accelerated performance review in 6 months.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Compensation & Benefits
Redwood Inference
From: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-15T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime Observability - expedited hire request (SLA commitment)

Kimberly — thanks. Answers below and attached files: offer_terms_draft.docx (model offer), comp_delta_estimates.xlsx (3-year TCO), HRREQ-7892 (tracker id).

1) Cost delta: S5 ceiling vs S4 midpoint 
- Delta (base + equity-run-rate): ~$28k/year in cash, ~$35k annualized when factoring equity run-rate; 3-year TCO including hiring costs ~ $150k incremental. See comp_delta_estimates.xlsx.

2) Budget owner: CS remediation fund (EchoHealth account) will cover 40%; PO-12489 references the remediation line item. Ben can confirm ledger code.

3) Stopping criteria / measurable objectives: 
- Reduce p99 end-to-end latency for EchoHealth dedicated workload from current baseline by 20% within 60 days of hire.
- Implement KV cache tracing and deploy three rollout mitigations that reduce tail events by 50% in synthetic repros.
- Instrumentation must ship to prod with dashboards and alerting for p95/p99 spikes.

Recruiting: Kate Liu (sourcer) is looped for intake; we propose a 2-week sourcing window + 1 week interview loop.

Attachments: offer_terms_draft.docx, comp_delta_estimates.xlsx

Logan

- Recruiting: Kate to proceed with intake; please include a clear interview rubric that tests for KV cache/debugging, large-scale tracing, and mitigation playbook design.
